title: 第5章  雪地里捡了个俏寡妇
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一晃神，就到了下午一点多钟。

要不是天上飘起了雪片子。

李阳还闷着头在山上找树，找得正起劲呢。

这地方早年不愧是旗人的庄子，林子里的树种就是杂。

短短几个钟头，他除了寻摸到十来样果树，还找着好些个打家具的好料子。

像核桃木、白蜡木、榆木、桦木、柞木、楸木、水曲柳、黄檗这些。

虽说眼下都还是小苗苗，拿空间一收倒也省事。

搁外头得百十来年才成材。

可李阳有空间能催着长，倒不怕用不上。

天上飘了雪，李阳瞅了眼手表，扭头就往山下走。

“明儿个要是不下雪，倒是能早点进山撵些野物。”李阳心里头盘算着。

“看看能不能打着些野兔野鸡啥的，搁空间里养起来。”

他也老长时间没尝着肉味儿了。这几年就算是蹲在城里，东西也短缺得不行。

就算手里攥着肉票，也得赶早去排大队。

有时候头天夜里就得去蹲着，要不根本抢不着。

加上他本来就爱吃白面。

所以每月都把那点肉票和布票拿去跟人淘换了。

不过往后就好了，自个儿有空间了，吃这块儿，就不用犯愁了。

“不能摆在明面上天天炖肉，得偷着来，省得招人眼红。”李阳心里头又叮嘱自己。

“得先在乡下整治好了，搁在空间仓库里，馋了再悄没声地掏点出来。”

就为了张嘴，李阳把心思都操碎了。

这年月家家户户都缺吃食。

人要是饿极了，啥事都干得出来，由不得他不加小心。

“看来等空间里那茬粮食收了，还有得忙活！”

有了粮食，他扔进空间的那几只鸡就有了嚼谷，往后就该抱窝了。

就算他明儿个进山啥也打不着，起码往后有鸡肉有鸡蛋吃。

“还得提前做下些干粮备着。面条、馒头、花卷、油条、烧饼、饺子、包子，每样都做些，全搁在空间里。”

空间仓库里头不走味儿，东西搁进去啥样，拿出来还是啥样，放多久也坏不了，倒是真方便。

李阳一边往山下走，一边在脑子里过那些个好吃的，嘴里头直泛口水。

刚下到山脚，冷不丁“砰”的一声闷响传过来，紧接着就有人“哎哟”叫唤了一嗓子。

“有人摔了？”李阳心里一紧，循着声就找过去了。

没走几步，拐过一道土坡，就瞅见不远处的烂泥沟里，歪着一个女人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In a blink of an eye, it was past one o'clock in the afternoon.

If it weren't for the flakes of snow falling from the sky.

Li Yang was still looking for trees on the mountain with his head down, and he was looking hard.

In the early years, this place was worthy of being the Zhuangzi of the Banner people, and the tree species in the forest were all mixed.

In just a few hours, in addition to finding about a dozen fruit trees, he also found many good materials for making furniture.

Such as walnut, ash, elm, birch, oak, catalpa wood, ash, cork, etc.

Although they are still little Miaomiao at the moment, it will be easier to take up the space.

It takes more than a hundred years to be successful outside.

But Li Yang has space to encourage growth, so he's not afraid that he won't be able to use it.

There was snow falling in the sky. Li Yang glanced at his watch, turned around and walked down the mountain.

"If it doesn't snow tomorrow, I can go into the mountains early to catch some wild animals." Li Yang was thinking in his mind.

"Let's see if we can catch some hares, pheasants, etc. and raise them in the space."

He also hadn't tasted meat for a long time.In the past few years, even if I was squatting in the city, things were in short supply.

Even if you have meat tickets in hand, you still have to go early and queue up.

Sometimes you have to squat the night before, otherwise you won't be able to grab it at all.

In addition, he loves to eat white noodles.

So every month I took the meat stamps and cloth stamps and exchanged them with others.

But it will be fine in the future. I will have some space. If I eat this, I won’t have to worry.

"You can't stew meat in public every day. You have to do it secretly to avoid attracting jealousy." Li Yang told himself again in his heart.

"It needs to be sorted out in the countryside first, put in the space warehouse, and then you can take some out quietly when you get greedy."

Just to open his mouth, Li Yang went to pieces.

Every household is short of food these days.

If a man is very hungry he can do anything, unless he is careful.

"It seems that after the grain in the space is harvested, there will still be work to do!"

With the food, the chickens he threw into the space would have food to chew on, and it would be time to build a nest in the future.

Even if he goes into the mountains tomorrow and can't catch anything, at least he will have chickens and eggs to eat in the future.

"You also need to prepare some dry food in advance. Noodles, steamed buns, flower rolls, fried dough sticks, sesame seed cakes, dumplings, and steamed buns. Make everything and put it all in the space."

There is no smell in the space warehouse. Things look the same when they are put in, and they still look the same when they are taken out. They will not break down no matter how long they are kept. It is really convenient.

As Li Yang walked down the mountain, he thought about the delicious food in his mind and drooled in his mouth.

As soon as we reached the foot of the mountain, there was a sudden "bang", followed by someone shouting "ouch".

"Someone fell?" Li Yang's heart tightened, and he followed the sound and looked for it.

After walking a few steps, I turned around a slope and saw a woman leaning in a mud ditch not far away.
